## ✨ KEPT v1.1.1

The first release from this repository: the complete KEPT app for the Solana Seeker.

- **Oaths with several habits:** each habit has its own proof object and its own live photo every day, checked by AI on the phone.
- **Bounties with several daily tasks:** a sponsor sets up to eight tasks (a gym check-in, a bench press, push-ups…), and entrants prove every one to stay in.
- **On Solana:** sign in with Mobile Wallet Adapter, Seeker Genesis Token check, SKR stakes escrowed by our Anchor program on Devnet.
- **Try the demo** needs no wallet, no SKR and no internet.
- **Cleanup:** removed unused code and strings, and fixed the version code so every release installs over the previous one.
